items.statement: The submitted calculation uses the pinned Au1·ClO4 record transformed to the anion-free +4 singlet cluster and validates the optimized Au4 geometry and atom mapping before AIM analysis.
items.expected: Explicit record 2500223, +4/ singlet state, deterministic anion/solvent removal, convergence evidence, four named edge contacts and four BCPs.

items.statement: The four Au···Au edge contacts are individually retained through BCP analysis with per-contact provenance.
items.expected: Au1-Au2, Au2-Au3, Au3-Au4 and Au4-Au1 each have a corresponding BCP row or a documented bounded failure.

items.statement: The AIM descriptors and DIs reproduce the four source-supported Au···Au contact patterns.
items.expected: Per-contact values agree with SI Table S2 within evaluator tolerances and DI values lie in the reported narrow range.

items.statement: The contact classification is predominantly closed-shell metallophilic with minor shared-shell character.
items.expected: The conclusion uses the |V|/G criterion and identifies the four contacts as metallophilic within the model boundary.
